# ps3dk.rsxcap.v1 marker, draw-descriptor and live ACK contract (Capture RSX frame, B1).  FROZEN.  The reader
# (ps3dk-prof src/rsx_capture.rs) is tested against these records now; the runtime marker and descriptor encoder
# (slice S2) and the live-protocol ACK encoder (slice S4) MUST be tested against these same records with the real
# reader when they are written.  Change a record only together with the format, never to fit one implementation.
#
# Format: UTF-8 text, one record per line.  Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored; a trailing CR is
# ignored.  Fields are separated by exactly one space.
#
#   TAG <id> <marker> <expect> <tag>
#     marker  begin | ckpt | end: the descriptor name is rsx.capture.begin / rsx.capture.ckpt / rsx.capture.end
#     expect  ok       the tag parses and satisfies the value rules
#             grammar  the grammar refuses the tag (an unparsable reserved tag)
#             value    the tag is grammatical but semantically invalid: cap 0 (reserved for refusals before a
#                      request is claimed), owner 0 in BEGIN/END (NONE is never a capture frame; frame 0 of a real
#                      owner is valid), a checkpoint block outside 0..=62, or an END block other than
#                      floor((hooks - 1) / 4096) (0 with zero counts when hooks = 0): an anomaly that blocks
#                      FINALIZED
#     tag     the rest of the line, verbatim except for three escapes: \s (a space; used where a space would be
#             invisible, at either end), \t (a tab) and \\ (a backslash)
#
#   DRAW <id> <expect> <name> <tag>
#     The runtime MUST register each draw-kind descriptor with the kind as its name and the tag
#     "ps3dk.rsxcap.v1 kind=<kind>" (kind: draw.arrays, draw.index, draw.inline, clear, clear.zcull).
#     name    the descriptor name (no spaces)
#     expect  draw     a genuine draw-kind descriptor (name and tag agree exactly)
#             fault    a draw-kind descriptor gone wrong (malformed tag, unknown kind, name/tag mismatch): a fault,
#                      which taints a capture whose interval it falls in
#             plain    not in the capture namespace (an ordinary app zone, even with a draw-kind name)
#     tag     as for TAG (empty for none)
#
#   ACK <id> <expect> <hex> [wire=<u32> state=<u32> reason=<u32> cap=<u32>]
#     hex     the ACK payload, two lowercase hex digits per byte (empty for a zero-length payload).  A 16-byte
#             payload is u32 little-endian wire id, state, reason, cap; the four key=value fields restate it.
#     expect  accepted | done | refused | abandoned   state 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
#             bad-state                                any other state: a protocol error
#             bad-length                               not 16 bytes: a protocol error (no fields given)
#     Reason values are opaque here (their numbering belongs to the live-protocol slice).
#
# Lengths: begin-max 121 bytes, ckpt-max-width 107, end-max-width 490 (every u32 at 10 digits, frame at 20, hooks
# and the five side counters at 262144); end-hooks-10-digits is 494 bytes (the writer's END buffer bound) and is
# refused because hooks > 262144.

# ---- canonical tags ----
